notes: Referrals and case closure: a referral that will not become a client is closed with a reason and its sender is emailed the outcome; a repeat referral attaches to the client already on file, reopening a closed record; closing a case records the reason and the employment or independence outcome, with a checklist of anything still open; due progress reports wait for a staff narrative (a task) unless automatic sending is turned on. Includes 3.0.34: Getting paid: your vendor number, remit-to address, tax ID and payment terms on every invoice (Administration, Billing details); invoices take any number of payments with the date received, write-offs with a reason, and can be closed as Denied or Void with their work released to be invoiced again; work outside an authorization's dates, hours or dollars is refused until it is amended; tracks can be VR, private pay (invoiced to the client) or no charge. Includes 3.0.33 (System health) and 3.0.32. Apply dist/migrations/mig_3.0.34.sql and then mig_3.0.35.sql before updating files (safe to re-run). Sites below 3.0.31 also apply mig_3.0.31.sql; Apply dist/migrations/mig_3.0.31.sql (confirms client emails waiting for confirmation). Sites below 3.0.28 apply mig_3.0.28.sql (adds scheduled_sessions.checked_in_at) before updating files; sites below 3.0.27 apply mig_3.0.27.sql first. Sites on 3.0.16 to 3.0.20 apply mig_3.0.21.sql first. Older sites apply mig_3.0.8, 3.0.9, 3.0.10, 3.0.12, 3.0.16, 3.0.21, 3.0.27, 3.0.28, 3.0.31, 3.0.34 and 3.0.35 in order; all are safe to re-run.
